notes.title: Demo Update
notes.content:
Major Improvements
Performance Settings
Performance settings have been added to help the game perform better on lower end devices. These settings include:

 Resolution
 Graphics
 FPS
Some players have been experiencing slow movement speed, glitchy animations and inconsistent gameplay experience. Lowering these new settings should help alleviate those issues.
New Upgrade System
You are now able to commune at a checkpoint to improve your health, stamina and weapon proficiency. Improve those using the silver coins you collect throughout the world.
New Items

Morning star: A powerful heavy mace that can break an enemy's stance.
Stamina dust: Consume this belt item to improve stamina regeneration rate over a small period of time
Reinforced pauldron: Trinket that improves armor and gives the player an extra layer of hyper armor that prevents flinching when being hit.
New Cutscene
A mysterious new cutscene has been added.


Quality of Life Improvements
Since the launch of Obsidian Legion's demo, back in October, we have received many comments and suggestions about ways to improve the game. We have tried to take into consideration as much feedback as we could and came up with many ways to improve the player experience. Here are some of the most notorious fixes we have made:

 Reduction of fall damage and more forgiving fall damage threshold;
 The Player won't drop from a ledge if they attack towards it;
 Elongated wall slide time, plus the players shakes when they are about to fall from the wall;
 The player can change direction in-between combos;
 "Coyote jump" added to the wall jump;
 Improved hyper armor mechanic and hyper armor is now displayed in the game UI;
 Skip cutscenes button;
 New background assets and various visual improvements;
 And many, many other bugs fixes and minor quality of life improvements.
As usual, your feedback is always welcomed. Do not hesitate to communicate your impressions about the content of this new update!
